ast.name: innerText
ast.source:
The Tasks plugin is not supported in Live Preview.
Please use reading mode.
ast.target:
Tasks 插件在实时预览中不受支持。
请使用阅读模式。

ast.name: innerText
ast.source: Caches rendered content in Live Preview to reduce render cycles and element flashing on note interaction.
ast.target: 在实时预览中缓存渲染内容，以减少笔记交互时的渲染周期和元素闪烁。

ast.name: innerText
ast.source: Only uses cache when a file Live Preview tab is open. If both reading view and Live Preview are opened this feature is disabled.
ast.target: 仅当文件实时预览标签页打开时使用缓存。如果同时打开阅读视图和实时预览，此功能将被禁用。

ast.name: innerText
ast.source: EXPERIMENTAL:
ast.target: 实验性功能：

ast.name: innerText
ast.source: This feature is experimental only and has intermittently caused notes to erase column content during development. A fix has been implemented                 but due to the potential data loss you must opt-in to using this feature. If content is erased you can use Undo to restore the file data.                 Please make backups and disable if you experience any data loss.
ast.target: 此功能仅为实验性功能，在开发过程中曾间歇性地导致笔记擦除列内容。已实施修复，但由于潜在的数据丢失风险，您必须选择启用此功能。如果内容被擦除，您可以使用撤销来恢复文件数据。请做好备份，如果遇到任何数据丢失，请禁用此功能。

ast.name: innerText
ast.source: Sets the defalut behavior when determining whether to align table to text alignment.
ast.target: 设置决定是否将表格与文本对齐方式对齐的默认行为。

ast.name: innerText
ast.source: This may take a while for large vaults, you can continue to use Obsidian but application may slow down during process.
ast.target: 对于大型仓库，这可能需要一些时间，您可以继续使用 Obsidian，但应用程序在处理过程中可能会变慢。

ast.name: innerText
ast.source: WARNING:
ast.target: 警告：

ast.name: innerText
ast.source: This action modifies any note file with depricated syntax and could lead to corrupted file text.
ast.target: 此操作会修改任何包含已弃用语法的笔记文件，并可能导致文件文本损坏。

ast.name: innerText
ast.source: No guarentee is given. Please make sure to back your vault up first.
ast.target: 不提供任何保证。请务必先备份您的仓库。

ast.name: innerText
ast.source: This will only modify column regions without a pre-defined ID, and which use the up to date core syntax. Will not modify depricated syntax or fenced-divs.
ast.target: 此操作仅会修改没有预定义ID且使用最新核心语法的列区域。不会修改已弃用的语法或围栏div。

ast.name: innerText
ast.source: This action modifies any note file missing column IDs and could lead to corrupted file text.
ast.target: 此操作会修改任何缺少列ID的笔记文件，可能导致文件文本损坏。
